concerns.text: Task T017 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but inserts calls to `utils.resource_monitor.record()` which write to a shared log file `logs/resource_usage.log`. Concurrent runs of the scripts could cause race conditions or interleaved log entries, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

Task T013 consumes raw EEG files in EDF/BDF format, yet the only producer of raw data (T012a) writes Parquet files. No task creates the required EDF/BDF files, so T013 has a consumer‑before‑producer dependency on missing EEG files.
